reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's B3 (per-platform tuned ladder) using delta_offset, K, and lag_samples coefficients lifted from out/results.json; applied per-segment with per-platform wheelbase L.
notes: Reconstructed B3 (per-platform tuned ladder) from out/results.json: yr = (v/L)*tan(delta - delta0) / (1 + K*v^2), then per-segment integer sample shift of lag_samples=-3 (60 ms lead). Pooled over 545 canonical Ford segments under v_mps>2.0.
